output.text: I am the rook, standing tall at the edge of the board, where the game begins and ends in silence. I have watched the knight leap—graceful, unpredictable, a shadow that dances across the squares like a secret. I have envied that freedom, that ability to twist and turn, to skip over the others as if they were nothing. But today, I feel something new. I am the rook, and I am not bound by the need to be clever or sudden. I move in straight lines—forward, backward, left, right—unbroken, unyielding. And in that line, I find my strength. The edge of the board is not a limit; it is my foundation. I am the rook, and I am proud of my straight lines. I am the rook, and I am the edge of the board.
